description: A community-first competitive gaming platform for beginners and casual players. It combines rank-based tournaments, simple progression, and social play.

features.name: Beginner Tournament Discovery and Registration
features.description: Players can discover and join rank-based beginner tournaments

scenarios.given: The user has completed onboarding, has a verified account, and has an assigned beginner rank
scenarios.when: The user opens the tournaments page and joins an eligible beginner tournament
scenarios.then: The system registers the user in the bracket and shows tournament details and start time

scenarios.given: The user attempts to join a tournament outside their current rank or region
scenarios.when: The system validates eligibility during registration
scenarios.then: The system blocks registration and explains why the tournament is unavailable

features.name: Team Creation and Management
features.description: Players can create teams, invite friends, and manage team roster

scenarios.given: The user is authenticated and has access to team features
scenarios.when: The user creates a team and sends invite links to friends
scenarios.then: A new team is created and invited users can accept and join the roster

scenarios.given: An active team exists with enough eligible members to enter a tournament
scenarios.when: The team owner joins a private or community team tournament
scenarios.then: The roster is locked for that event and all eligible team members are registered

features.name: Player Progression and Badges
features.description: Players earn visible badges and level progression through tournament participation

scenarios.given: The user has completed matches or tournaments that qualify for progression rewards
scenarios.when: Match and tournament results are finalized
scenarios.then: The system updates the player's profile with points, badges, and progression status

functional.description: The system shall show only tournaments that match the user's eligible rank and region
The system shall allow a player to register for a tournament with one primary action
The system shall confirm registration and display tournament timing, format, and expected next step
The system shall validate rank, region, and account status before completing registration
The system shall show a clear reason when a player is not eligible for a tournament
The system shall allow a user to create a team with a unique name
The system shall generate shareable invites for friend onboarding and team joining
The system shall display current roster status and pending invites
The system shall validate team size and player eligibility before team tournament entry
The system shall lock the roster at registration or at a defined cutoff time
The system shall award progression points based on tournament participation and outcomes
The system shall display earned badges and progression history on the player profile

nonFunctional.description: Tournament eligibility check shall complete in under 2 seconds for 95% of requests
The registration flow shall be available on mobile and desktop responsive layouts
The system shall prevent duplicate registrations for the same tournament
Eligibility validation shall not expose internal logic or sensitive anti-abuse rules
Error messages shall be understandable to first-time users
Team creation shall complete in under 3 seconds for 95% of requests
Invite links shall be secure and expire or be revocable by the owner
Roster lock behavior shall be consistent and auditable
Team tournament registration shall handle concurrent updates safely
Progression updates shall be processed reliably after event completion
Badge and profile data shall load within acceptable profile-view latency targets
